provenance: One keyless HTTPS GET of receipts_url, taken at fetched_at and stored here as the server's own list of {hash, receipt} envelopes, unmodified and in the order it served them. receipts_response_sha256 is over the exact response body; this file is that body re-serialised sorted and indented, so the two digests are different by construction and both are recorded. The query string is load-bearing and is part of the citation: a bare /receipts returns the newest 250 receipts and nothing says so in the response, ?offset= and ?all= are accepted and ignored, and only ?limit= widens the window — so a reader who drops it recomputes a different, shorter chain that still links internally. Unlike a live market snapshot this corpus is re-fetchable: SOLVENT published its last receipt at 2026-06-29T01:01:04Z and has published nothing since, so the chain is closed at seq 383 and the same URL returned the same 1,752,554 bytes on two fetches taken minutes apart.
